tastes.label: Spectacle
tastes.tagline: Senior creative courage — monumental type, motion, interactive surfaces
tastes.typographyDirection: Monumental display voice — condensed grotesk, stretched sans, stencil, or intentional serif only when type IS the visual (404/hero). Not default for checkout, auth, or pricing forms.
interactionDefaults: Pointer or scroll affects at least one visual layer
Solid scrub if drag mechanic fits the product metaphor
tastes.goalHint: One bold visual idea at senior creative bar — not a SaaS template.
antiPatterns: Split SaaS hero with orb nodes
Decorating because empty space feels scary

tastes.label: Editorial restraint
tastes.tagline: Quiet portfolio craft — system UI, lists, whitespace, hover reveals
tastes.typographyDirection: System UI for body (SF Pro, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont) + ONE expressive accent for section labels (handwritten, serif italic, or mono). Hierarchy through size and weight, not decoration.
interactionDefaults: One signature micro-interaction per section (hover preview, expand, subtle reveal)
List rows with right-aligned meta (date, view, year)
tastes.goalHint: Feels Apple-editorial — reduction, breathing room, one hover moment per block. Pleasing without spectacle.
stealList: Narrow centered column with huge margins
Hover preview card or expand — not page-wide scrub
Grain or soft shadow on one accent surface
antiPatterns: Dark full-bleed hero with scrub interaction
Forcing custom display font when system UI is correct
Feature grid or three icon columns

tastes.label: Minimal
tastes.tagline: Typographic silence — almost nothing on screen
tastes.typographyDirection: One type family, two weights max. Silence is the concept. Links as underlines.
tastes.goalHint: 3 elements max. Every pixel must earn its place.

tastes.label: Expressive
tastes.tagline: Personality-forward — accent type, color pops, still disciplined structure
tastes.typographyDirection: Sans body + one small accent voice max (mono digits, script section label). No variable serif on form headlines or checkout titles.
interactionDefaults: Accent color on one surface only
tastes.goalHint: Memorable voice — handwritten sections, bookshelf, experiment previews — structured, not chaotic.
stealList: Expressive section headers vs clean body

tastes.label: Developer blueprint
tastes.tagline: Grid-as-design — meta labels, code + preview, atmospheric glow
tastes.typographyDirection: Clean sans (Inter, SF Pro) + mono for code. Meta labels show tokens/classes used on the page itself.
interactionDefaults: Visible grid lines as layout system
Soft glow as depth layer — not the whole hero
Search or focus states with purpose
tastes.goalHint: Product-native layout — Tailwind-style blueprint grid, self-documenting UI, proof in the demo.
stealList: Smooth glow behind grid — atmosphere only
antiPatterns: Grid dots as fake decoration without structure
